subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customers, We are excited to announce that we have added new payment options to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now pay using Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal at checkout. These secure and easy-to-use options will streamline the payment process for you. Feel free to reach out to our customer support team if you have any questions or need assistance. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs!
